/* selectMasterWmReReturnMultiRegList */ SELECT TRXL.TARGET AS BUYER_CODE ,( SELECT IC.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY IC WHERE IC.COM_CODE = TRXL.TARGET ) AS BUYER_NAME ,TRXL.KEY_1 AS PO_NO ,TRXL.KEY_2 AS PO_SEQ ,PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO ,PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO ,PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION ,PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION ,PODT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE ,( SELECT IC.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY IC WHERE IC.COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT ) AS SELLER_NAME ,POHD.AGENT AS SELLER ,PODT.PROCESS_TYPE ,CASE WHEN PODT.PROCESS_TYPE IN ('1', '3') THEN ( SELECT DISTINCT COD2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE COD2.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD2.TYPE = 'WR01' AND COD2.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD2.TEXT2 = POHD.AGENT ) ELSE PODT.WAREHOUSE_CODE END AS WAREHOUSE_CODE ,PRDT.ADD_USER_DEPT AS BUYER_DEPT_CODE ,( SELECT IC.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 IC WHERE 1=1 AND COMPANY_CODE = TRXL.TARGET AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = PRDT.ADD_USER_DEPT ) AS BUYER_DEPT_NAME ,PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME AS BUYER_USER_NAME ,PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL AS BUYER_USER_TEL ,TRXL.KEY_3 AS B_REQ_DATE ,TRXL.KEY_6 AS B_REQ_REMARK ,PODT.ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY ,NVL(( SELECT SUM(WMRE.WMRE_QTY) FROM BNTWMRE WMRE WHERE WMRE.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND WMRE.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND WMRE.PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND WMRE.CANCEL_DATE IS NULL) , 0 ) AS TOTAL_WMRE_QTY ,TRXL.KEY_5 AS WMRE_QTY ,TRXL.KEY_4 AS WMRE_TYPE ,TRXL.KEY_7 AS M_REC_DATE ,TRXL.KEY_8 AS M_REC_REMARK ,TRXL.KEY_9 AS WMRE_TYPE2 ,TRXL.KEY_10 AS WMRE_TYPE3 ,TRXL.KEY_11 AS WMRE_TYPE_DETAIL ,NVL(( SELECT COUNT(RS.PO_NO) FROM ICOMPORS RS WHERE RS.BUYER =PODT.BUYER AND RS.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND RS.PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ) , 0) AS STATUS_BACK_CODE ,PRDT.STATUS AS PRDT_STATUS ,PODT.STATUS AS PODT_STATUS ,POHD.STATUS AS POHD_STATUS ,TRXL.KEY_13 AS DELIVERY_FLAG FROM BNTTRXL TRXL , ICOMPODT PODT , ICOMPRDT PRDT , ICOMPOHD POHD WHERE 1=1 AND PRDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PRDT.PR_NO = PODT.PR_NO AND PRDT.PR_SEQ = PODT.PR_SEQ AND POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND TRXL.TARGET = PODT.BUYER AND TRXL.KEY_1 = PODT.PO_NO AND TRXL.KEY_2 = PODT.PO_SEQ AND TRXL.KEY_12 = #{st_user_id} AND TRXL.DOC_NAME = 'BNTWMRE'
AND PODT.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code}
